Confluence 2: Quarter Theory & MSNR Alignment. The 78000.00 major quarter level acts as a psychological magnet and horizontal support (MSNR). Confluence 4: Candle Range Theory (CRT) & BOS. The current H4 candle executed a classic AMD (Accumulation-Manipulation-Distribution) cycle, sweeping the previous H4 low of 76746.95 down to 76046.58 before breaking structure (BOS) to the upside on H1. The pullback to 78025.00 represents the mitigation phase of this expansion.

Confluence 5: Momentum & Multi-Timeframe Trend. While the HTF H4 trend is technically bearish, the H1, M15, and M5 trends are strongly bullish. The M15 RSI at 70.3 confirms powerful bullish momentum; a temporary cooling off to the 78000 area will reset momentum indicators while maintaining structural alignment.
